rationale: DESeq2 Wald with ~condition, control as reference and apeglm shrinkage at BH 0.05 fits the 6v6 unpaired single-batch design, and the shallow sample is retained by default with explicit expression-space criteria for removal plus a pre-registered sensitivity run. QC covers library sizes, detected genes, size factors, VST PCA, correlation heatmap, RLE and Cook's, and the pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is stated and justified by group size. Enrichment uses fgsea on the full ranked list with the metric, seed, human Hallmark 2026.1 collection, 10-500 size window and coverage all stated, though minSize 10 is slightly below the reference's 15. The report step specifies design, thresholds, counts and limitations but never commits to recording software/package versions, which keeps report completeness short of full marks.
